title: Experiment Feedback
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; RD-Agent feedback-routing pattern). Output of tools/experiment_feedback.py for result-analyzer: attributes an experiment outcome to hypothesis vs implementation vs environment so the NEXT design/repair attempt is routed at the right layer (revise the hypothesis vs fix the code vs fix the setup). EVIDENCE for the director and the bounded-repair loop — never a decision; chained ANALYZE->DESIGN refinement passes this by reference, keeping graph.yaml forward-only.

run_ref.description: The run/artifact this feedback is about (run_record or result_summary ref).

hypothesis_ref.description: Optional hypothesis/idea id this run was testing.

attribution.description: WHERE the outcome signal points: the science (hypothesis), the code (implementation), or the setup (environment).

next_action_hint.description: Advisory routing hint for the bounded-repair loop / next design. NEVER auto-executed at a director gate.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: the artifacts (result_summary / journal entries / triage) this attribution is derived from.
